phrases.english: I have a cat and a dog at home.
phrases.pronunciation: Ladai qittah wa kalb fil manzil.
phrases.context: To state the pets you own.

phrases.english: The birds are singing beautifully this morning.
phrases.arabic: الطيور تغرد بشكل جميل هذا الصباح.
phrases.pronunciation: At-toyūr tugharrid bishakl jameel hadha as-sabah.
phrases.context: To describe the sounds of birds.

phrases.english: I love seeing horses run in the field.
phrases.arabic: أحب رؤية الخيول وهي تركض في الحقل.
phrases.pronunciation: Uhibbu ru'yatan al-khuyool wa hiya tarkud fil haql.

phrases.english: Can you see that elephant at the zoo?
phrases.arabic: هل ترى ذلك الفيل في حديقة الحيوان؟
phrases.pronunciation: Hal tara thalika al-feel fi hadiqatal hayawan?
phrases.context: To point out an elephant to someone.

phrases.english: My friend is allergic to cats.
phrases.context: To inform someone about an allergy to cats.
